model.summary_ko:
r4.5 (비틀림 스프링 → 미스미 C-UA90R5-3-0.5) 반영을 끝냈다. 먼저 r4.4 상태를 final_r4_4/에 백업했다(work*, __pycache__ 제외).

**1. 스프링 값을 따로 다시 유도했고 요청서와 같다.**
- 카탈로그 k 0.1368 / 0.1409 / 0.1454 N·mm/°를 n = 3 + (180 − 암 각)/360으로 풀면 E가 186,048 / 185,941 / 186,014 MPa로 한 값에 모인다. 그래서 E = 186 GPa를 썼다.
- 다리를 긴 22.3(접점에서 22.13), 짧은 2.5로 자르면 N_e 3.725, k_t 8.866 N·mm/rad(0.1547/°)이다. 같은 식에 카탈로그 다리 25/25를 넣으면 0.1368/°가 나와 카탈로그와 맞는다.
- b = 0 토크 4.189를 지키는 자유각은 −27.07°다.
- 응력(K_i 1.073): 쉼 366, 바닥 537, 서비스 583, 손 들기 25°에서 704 MPa(Su의 33 %).
- 손 들기 감긴 각 52.1°는 카탈로그 최대 55° 안이다. 다만 토크 8.06은 카탈로그 55° 토크 7.52의 107 %다. 빼기 절차의 들어올림 15.5°는 한계 각 21.5° 아래다.
- 고침 2·2b가 바꾼 칼라·옆벽·보스·질량·접착은 주머니 구간과 스프링 식에 닿지 않는다. 그래서 요청서 파라미터 표에서 바꿀 값은 없었다.

**2. 모델(model_v4.py)에 넣은 것.**
- 스프링 파라미터: spring_E, spring_swept_free 1170, spring_T0를 넣고 k_t와 자유각은 모델이 계산하게 했다.
- 주머니 Ø6.6, 슬롯 ±3.25.
- 뒷벽 홈: 2.4 × 3.2, 바닥 y211.0, 뒷벽 1.0 남음. 보스 4.4.
- 새 짧은 다리 홈: 접점 230.36°, 띠 1.70~3.00, 바깥 면이 받는 면이다. 허브 벽을 뚫고 웹 밑면을 1.21 깎는다. 그래서 주머니 구간이 A·B 두 조각이 됐다.
- 새 함수: spring_short_leg_lf, spring_notch_geo, spring_insert_check, hub_notch_stress, pocket_section_removed, spring_mass.
- 넣기 검사(선 외곽, 0.02 mm 걸음): 짧은 다리 틈 0.53, 공차 뒤 0.23. 요청서의 '0.5면 막힘'은 중심선 판정이라 보수적이다. 선 외곽으로 재면 0.5에서 0.25로 지나가지만, 공차를 넣으면 모자라 0.8을 그대로 둔다.
- 긴 다리는 코일 +x 끝에 와야 한다. 오른쪽 감기이기 때문이고, 뒤집으면 짧은 다리가 105°에 와서 홈에 맞지 않는다.
- 허브·웹 강도(ABUSE): 층 안 3.97 MPa, Kt 2를 곱해 7.95(한계 25). 조각 B 층간 0.17. 봉 지압은 양옆 허브만으로 1.45.
- 레버 질량 57.05 → 56.97 g. 주머니 구간에서 빠진 것 전체를 빼도록 고쳤고, 스프링은 0.126 g이다.

**3. run_all 전체를 다시 돌렸다(1079 s). 판정 42개 모두 통과.**
- DW·UW는 같다(51.92 / 51.01).
- 행정 중 DW 최대 54.36 → 54.76, 바닥 UW 34.50 → 34.89.
- 연타 16.23 → 16.30 Hz, 마찰 2배 15.19 → 15.26 Hz.
- 스윕 최소 1.31(공차 뒤 1.01)로 그대로, 겹침 0.
- 비용 +43,400 → +69,400원: 스프링 100 × 310 = 31,000원, 경선 니퍼 15,000원(추정).
- DESIGN.md r4.5: 새 1f장, D05·P18, 2.2, 16, 18장 문장·위험 추가.

**4. 단계 0과 공구.**
- C06a 홈을 2.4 × 3.2로, C06b를 모델 주머니·슬롯·짧은 다리 홈 복제로 바꿨다.
- 시험 8 합격 숫자: 쉼 4.19 / 바닥 6.14 N·mm ±15 %.
- 시험 13은 짧은 다리 홈에 넣기 시험으로 바꿨다(C16a 3개).
- 가짜 레버 캡스턴 힘은 1.530 N으로 실제 1.499 N과 +2 % 차이다. 이는 r4.4와 같고, 앞 높이 차 0.004 mm라 고칠 필요 없음.
- 회로 인터페이스는 그대로다.

resolved.item: 2. Model implementation: pocket, slot, rear-wall groove, boss, short-leg groove, spring_geometry, hub_pocket_poly, insertion path check

errors.issue: The steel is now held in by the epoxy bond, but thermal-mismatch shear in that bond is never checked. The design's own plate model says the snap lips alone open 0.79-1.20 mm against a 1.0 mm overhang on every note, so if the bond lets go, the steel can drop out. The bond is 5-minute epoxy (rigid, and it softens at about 40-50 C) joining 0.8 mm PETG walls (CTE about 60e-6/K) to SS400 (11.7e-6/K) along 40 mm. The Volkersen end shear from that mismatch is far above both the 1.0 MPa allowable for rare loads and the 2.0 MPa design strength, and it happens on every temperature swing, not just on rare events. Stage-0 test 20 is run at room temperature only, so it would not find this.
errors.evidence: v_bond_thermal.txt uses tau_max = sqrt(Ga*E_w*t_w/ta)*dAlpha*dT with E_w*t_w = 2000*0.8 and a shear-lag length of 0.3-0.5 mm, so the 40 mm faces act as infinitely long. For 5-min epoxy (G about 700 MPa) with a bond line ta of 0.1 mm, which is what 0.15 mL over 1411 mm2 gives: 1.62 / 3.23 / 4.85 MPa at dT 10 / 20 / 30 K. With ta 0.05: 2.29 / 4.57 / 6.86 MPa. With ta 0.02: 3.6 / 7.2 / 10.8 MPa. By comparison the model's per-note mechanical shear is 0.067 MPa and ABUSE is 0.099 MPa, against allowables of 0.50 and 1.00 (P bond_tau 2.0, sf 4 / 2). §18 itself says that if the bond fails the steel falls onto the key beam, and that note stops working.
errors.fix: This adds no parts. (1) Specify a flexible adhesive such as an MS-polymer or hybrid sealant-adhesive, or an RTV with primer (G about 1 MPa). With ta 0.05-0.1 the thermal edge shear is then 0.11-0.25 MPa even at dT 30 K. Mechanical shear stays 0.067 / 0.099 MPa, and the steel-to-carrier slip under a 90 N pad hit is about 0.007 mm, which is negligible. Alternatively, use a toughened flexible epoxy (G of 50 MPa or less) with a bond line of at least 0.1. (2) Add a dT term (for example +/-25 K) to steel_bond() and add it to the 0.2 row. (3) In test 20, run 3 cycles of 5 C to 45 C (freezer / warm water bath or a car) before the 116 N push and the drop.

errors.issue: As written, the bond that retention now depends on cannot be made as the model assumes. The steel pocket has zero nominal clearance: in geometry.json, steel x29.535-38.535 equals the inner faces of the carrier walls, since 10.6 - 2 x 0.8 = 9.0 = steel_w. Yet parts_list.json / DESIGN §4 and the §16 consumable row say to bond the 19x40 faces 'after snapping in' (스냅으로 끼운 뒤), and 5-min epoxy cannot wick into a zero gap. The assembly sequence in DESIGN §10, step 3, only says to snap the steel in from below and has no bonding step at all. Only stage0_procedure.md test 20, step 3, applies epoxy to the faces first and then snaps. The modelled 1411 mm2 over a 0.1 mm film therefore exists only if the stage-0 method is followed. The far wall is also printed over a support with a 0.2 z gap, so the width of the bond line is set by FDM tolerance and by the few-tenths-of-a-mm thickness tolerance of hot-rolled flat bar.

errors.issue: The control board cannot be installed in the one-piece module frame. A board with a front-open slot can only take the foot by sliding FORWARD from 25.2 mm behind its seat (foot rear y170.7 minus board front y145.5). The model defines a PET shim under a pad as moving the face 0.1 down, so the lever meets it 0.23 deg earlier and the gap becomes more negative. A more negative gap makes the strip bite at a higher force (-0.30 / -0.40 / -0.50 -> 0.75 / 0.92 / 1.04 N). So an early bite (gap not negative enough) needs a shim added, and a late bite needs one removed. As written, the builder moves the gap away from the target. With no default shim, 'remove' is often impossible anyway. The stage-0 kit's own mapping (test T: thicker pad -> remove shims; test 1 alternative 1: -0.60 = two more shims) agrees with the model, so DESIGN 12 contradicts the kit.

errors.issue: Coil float on the rod is not modelled. It removes about 41 % of the rest torque, and three PLAY targets then fail. The coil ID (5.0) sits on the Ø4 rod with 0.44 radial clearance at rest after wind-up (0.41 at the bottom); r4.4 had 0.20. The short leg pushes on its bearing face with 1.68 N at a 2.5 mm arm, and the long leg pushes with only 0.20 N. The net 1.56 N pushes the coil toward 56°. That direction is inside the 35° slot opening, which spans -45° to 115° at r3.3, so no pocket wall stops the coil; only the rod does. The shifted coil OD stays 0.16 from piece A and 0.48 from piece B. The short leg moves 0.44 off the bearing face, and the spring unwinds 11.4° until the leg tip touches the face again. The long leg's re-tangent angle changes by 0.4°, so the net loss is 11.0°. Rest torque drops from 4.19 to 2.49 N·mm; bottom torque drops from 6.14 to 4.57. The spring then behaves like k_eff 9.45 N·mm/rad with free angle -15.1°. The coil is also pressed onto the rod with about 1.6–2.3 N, which adds coil/rod friction hysteresis that the model does not include. Side effect: a keyless lever now unloads its long leg from b ≈ -15°, not -27°, so at -31.3° the leg tip is about 3 mm outside the groove mouth at nominal. The model says 1.37 inside.
errors.fix: No added parts. (1) Add the float equilibrium to the model: coil against the rod along the net leg force, then the short leg rotated until it touches the face again. (2) Put the installed torque back by rotating the short-leg notch about 11° clockwise (α_s 230.4° → about 219.4°, same swept angle), then rerun the insertion, hub-strength and sweep checks. Moving the groove bottom cannot make up an 11° shortfall: 11° × 0.367 mm/° is about 4 mm, and only 1.0 mm of rear wall is left.
